verdict.text: The state line now picks concept or concepts, and handoff or handoffs, by count, and a new test covers the count of one.
The fix broke nothing: all gates and rows r1 to r6 pass, and the briefing is still 424 words on this repository.
`loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: lint, format, tests and eval rows r1 to r6 pass, "stamp green: 3fa9589c04f88cf7758622eef053fcfbe626e1bd9b1c2628250cf6cfdc33eb24".
`render` sets the noun from `s.due == 1` and `s.live_handoffs == 1`, so 0 and 2 or more stay plural.
The State dataclass and the JSON shape did not change, so r2 and r6 still hold.
The new test builds a fresh bundle (`init` leaves only the manifesto due) with one handoff and asserts "1 concept due for review" and "1 live handoff,".
Both strings would fail under the old plural text.

Ran `kmctl briefing` on this repository: 424 words, "State: 10 concepts due for review (kmctl review due); 0 live handoffs." f1 and f2 were not sent back, so I only checked them: the r1 test now asserts "Knowledge in this repository" and "Verbs:", which appear only in the routing part, and the budget test imports WORD_BUDGET.
